tasks.title: Activate reachable fail-closed Founder Beta Continuity after the first bounded attempt was independently falsified
tasks.context_query: Founder Beta Continuità reachable Room navigation lesson session FSA persistence corrupt legacy recovery evidence ARD-05 ARD-06 D-SUPERFICI
acceptance: The real Room navigation path derives exact lessonId and sessionId from the live LessonOS identity after durable flush and reaches the scoped Continuity runtime through the existing production router; an unscoped legacy dashboard link is never treated as Founder Beta Continuity.
Route and scope validation occurs before opening IndexedDB, WorkspaceStore, journal, scene or any other persistence boundary.
IndexedDB unavailability, in-memory fallback, FSA handle loss, data loss and corrupt storage remain typed fail-closed states and can never collapse into verified empty or ready.
Raw stored LessonOS envelopes receive strict runtime validation before projection; malformed same-scope data, duplicate identity or invalid sequence becomes corrupt rather than a generic load error.
Legacy journal recovery evidence emits legacy-recovery-required instead of being silently filtered into a verified empty session.
Required build and evidence sources are represented honestly; missing build provenance or unresolved evidence cannot produce a verified ready fact.
Cold reopen uses fresh real adapter instances, proves the second adapters were consulted and reconstructs the same scoped projection without a shared process-local cache.

Non-tautological adversarial tests cover real navigation, zero-I/O invalid scope, cross-session isolation, persistence fallback, legacy recovery, malformed envelopes, evidence grounding and cold reopen; full Studio test, typecheck and build gates pass.
forbidden_changes: No dependency, package manifest, schema migration or route alias outside the five admitted files.
No merge, deploy, push, main write or network publication.
No global event-log or journal fallback, no localStorage-as-authority, no product mocks and no weakened test or gate.
No claim that Simulation is verified before ARD-07 receipts and no ready state without required evidence.
